source: export.monster.Monster23.initBBDC()+setAction() in 打开我开始玩.swf; sheet 3.swf chid5 Monster23. 哮天犬 (Xiaotian Dog), 二郎神's companion. Single-branch constructor. In the original, Monster22's __added() override auto-spawns this species at the boss's position (`MainGame.getInstance().createMonster(23,...)`) — it is not part of any StageListener's waitForRegisterDataArray. hp is 9999999 (effectively unkillable by design; it's a scripted companion, not a normal kill target) — recorded verbatim per the fidelity mandate; level3.ts folds it into the final grunt wave as a documented adaptation since the LevelDef schema has no companion/escort concept. setAction's "dead" case has NO bbdc frame row — it calls dropAura()+destroy() immediately, so this species has no death animation asset (not an omission bug, confirmed by rows 0-5 covering exactly wait/walk/hurt/hit1/hit2/hit3 with none left over for dead).
